verdict.rationale: Bruno AI has a first-party feature for this: in the Tests tab you click the AI icon, describe what to assert, and Bruno generates test code to review before accepting. It also offers ghost-text suggestions in the Tests editor, and the chat sidebar can write tests (e.g. a response-time check). Separately, documented agent workflows generate collections with test cases from backend source code. missing for 10: explicit evidence that tests are derived from an OpenAPI spec or from captured responses (rather than a user prompt), and independent or hands-on corroboration of output quality.
